title: Guitar Effects
changes: Play through a full effects rig: gate, compressor, drives, EQ, modulation, delay, reverb, amps and cabs
Neural Amp Modeler support with bundled models and your own .nam files
Effects drawer under the fretboard so you can practise scales with your tone on
Click any pedal in the drawer to open it and tweak the knobs
Modern and Classic (real stompbox) pedal styles
Input and output level meters with clip lights
Built-in tuner in the effects drawer
NIXX presets: Clean, Clean Sky, Funk, Blues OD, Butter OD, Drive, Lead and Metal
Save your own patches in the browser

title: Multi-Instrument Support
changes: Added instrument selector popup on first visit
Added Bass (4, 5, 6 string) fretboards
Added Ukulele fretboard
Instrument choice saved in cookies
Dynamic fretboard adapts strings, tuning, and layout per instrument
Tuner now matches selected instrument
Replaced toolbar icons with readable text labels
Added version info footer with changelog
Added key selector to backing track generator
Darkened fretboard with subtle wood grain texture

title: Bends, Slides & Annotations
changes: Bend markers with half, full, and 1.5 step indicators
Drag-to-connect slide lines between notes
Click empty frets to add outside notes
Double-click to highlight notes
Click to hide scale notes for practice
Download fretboard as PNG (dots only or with fretboard)
Scale comparison side-by-side view

title: Initial Release
changes: Interactive SVG fretboard with 22 scales
3NPS, CAGED, and Diagonal pattern modes
Note and interval display modes with rotation
Built-in metronome with tap tempo
Guitar tuner with pitch detection
Backing track generator
Adjustable fret range (1-24)
Scale info panel and practice tips
